segments.title: Google just made its own AirTag
segments.say: Google just made its own AirTag. It's called Pixel Tag, and it's on sale now.

segments.title: Lost keys? Ring them
segments.say: Lost your keys? Ring them, or follow the arrow.

segments.title: What Google says
segments.say: Google says the battery lasts up to a year. And up to ten people can share one tag.

segments.title: It warns you too
segments.say: If an unknown tag travels with you, your phone warns you.

segments.title: The catch: Android only
segments.say: The catch? Android only. Not tested by us.

segments.sub: to the friend who always loses their keys
segments.say: Send this to the friend who always loses their keys.
